items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You should try walking after meals to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Try to avoid eating dinner late, as sugar is linked to a rise about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. You've been doing a good job of not eating dinner late, with none of your 16 scored dinners starting at 8 pm or later.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You're doing a great job of fasting overnight, with an average of 14.0 hours and 92.9% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching is linked to a change in HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
